_source: Neo's own pricing sheet (Google Sheets 1PAdQGTl6yqHYqDIBq5jYdVunnKe6LQYB12j6Fb45ID8), read 27 Aug 2026. India (INR) column. These are REAL Neo prices — unlike the DomScan domain figures, which are a third-party registrar's and are labelled 'approx' on screen.
_units: All INR figures are PER MAILBOX PER MONTH for mail, and PER MONTH for site, at the stated billing cycle. Longer cycles are cheaper per month but billed upfront.

mail._note: Lite has no monthly option in the sheet (shown as '-') — it starts at quarterly. 'afterFirstCycle' is the renewal rate once the introductory cycle ends; it is higher than the intro rate for every plan except Lite, which is flat.
